_description: Traditional balance of only $30k with a requested $100k conversion. Verifies conversion is capped at available Traditional balance.
_rationale: Age 60 (no RMD). Traditional $30k, requested conversion $100k. Available for conversion = tradBal - RMD = 30k - 0 = 30k. So rothConversionGross should be capped at 30,000. No taxable account, no spending. Tax draws from the conversion itself — effectively conversion gross minus tax ends up as net Roth gain.
name: Roth Conversion — Capped by Balance
